# Moseley Collins

> Sacramento-based personal injury law firm with 40+ years of experience representing clients across California in accident, medical malpractice, and civil rights cases.

Moseley Collins is a full-service personal injury law practice operating across Sacramento, Los Angeles, and San Diego with a focus on catastrophic injury cases, wrongful death, and police misconduct litigation. The firm combines extensive legal expertise with community service commitments to nonprofits serving underserved populations.

## Core Practice Areas

- [Practice Areas](https://www.moseleycollins.com/areas-of-practice.html): Overview of practice areas including car accidents, birth injuries, brain injuries, and amputation cases.
- [Car Accident Lawyers](https://www.moseleycollins.com/car-accident.html): Car accident legal services in Sacramento with free consultation and compensation guidance.
- [Medical Malpractice Attorney](https://www.moseleycollins.com/medical-malpractice.html): Medical malpractice legal representation for negligence and standard of care violations.
- [Birth Injury Attorney](https://www.moseleycollins.com/birth-injury.html): Birth injury legal services covering cerebral palsy, Erb's palsy, and delivery complications.
- [Truck Accident Lawyer](https://www.moseleycollins.com/truck-big-rig-accident.html): Truck and big rig accident legal representation for catastrophic commercial vehicle injuries.
- [Motorcycle Accident Lawyer](https://www.moseleycollins.com/motorcycle-accident.html): Motorcycle accident attorney services with 40 years experience and fair settlements.
- [Wrongful Death Attorney](https://www.moseleycollins.com/wrongful-death.html): Wrongful death legal representation for negligence-related fatalities and family compensation.
- [Police Misconduct Lawyers](https://www.moseleycollins.com/police-misconduct-lawyer-in-sacramento-county-ca.html): Police misconduct and excessive force legal representation for civil rights violations.
- [Slip and Fall Attorney](https://www.moseleycollins.com/slip-and-fall.html): Premises liability and slip-and-fall injury claims from unsafe property conditions.
- [Amputation Lawyer](https://www.moseleycollins.com/amputation.html): Amputation injury legal services covering limb loss from accidents or medical negligence.
